set.body: Serve as the final canonical gate for the linked ScalaFIM execution epic. Verify that dense NeuroVol and NeuroVec behavior is provided by image4s plus Ravel, sparse data uses support or GridDomain plus compact Ravel storage, and no ScalaFIM multidimensional-array, geometry, raw-offset, or duplicate-kernel hierarchy remains. Run cross-platform image4s gates, downstream ScalaFIM consumer and serialization or I/O gates, compatibility tests, and the frozen matched performance court with checksums and allocation receipts. Record any visible regression rather than hiding it behind internal benchmarks. Acceptance: the ScalaFIM execution mirror is closed with evidence; public migration guidance is complete; duplicate removal is proven safe; mig-500 may proceed.
set.title: Prove unified image consumers and authorize duplicate removal
